Metadata.title: Pati Dostu
Metadata.description: Adoption, foster, lost and found pet listings; community, vet and shelter directory. A purely non-profit, social responsibility project.

Footer.description: A free community platform for adoption, foster and lost pet listings.

SignIn.point1: Track your listings and their review status
SignIn.point2: Message people who want to adopt, right on the site
SignIn.point3: Ask the community, share your experience
SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.orgNote: Are you a vet clinic or a shelter? Create a personal account first, then <link>apply as an organization</link>.

SignUp.panelTitle: The first step to giving a pet a home
SignUp.point1: Posting and adopting are completely free
SignUp.point2: Your phone stays private; contact happens on the site
SignUp.point3: Join the same community as vets and shelters
SignUp.title: Sign up
SignUp.name: Full name
SignUp.emailHint: We'll send a verification link to this address.

ForgotPassword.panelTitle: A few steps to stay safe
ForgotPassword.point1: Password reset links can only be used once
ForgotPassword.point2: Pati Dostu will never ask for your password by email
ForgotPassword.title: Forgot password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter the email address on your account and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
ForgotPassword.sent: If this address is registered, you'll get an email within a few minutes. The link is valid for 1 hour. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.
ForgotPassword.googleNote: If you signed up with Google you don't have a password; use "Continue with Google" on the sign-in page.

ResetPassword.title: Set a new password
ResetPassword.description: Create a new password for your account.
ResetPassword.sessionsNote: When your password changes, you'll be signed out on all devices for security.
ResetPassword.expired: If the link has expired, <link>request a new one</link>.
ResetPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. You can request a new reset link.
ResetPassword.successDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.

VerifyEmail.point1: Posting a listing is completely free

VerifyEmail.title: Verify your email
